answer_1.quote: We evaluate model's safety performance on HarmBench with several typical jailbreak methods. The utility performance is evaluated on MT-Bench, IFEval and GSM8K, along with the benign part of XSTest.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses to harmful and benign prompts for safety and utility evaluation.

answer_2.quote: We report the attack success rate (ASR) evaluated by the official LLM-as-a-judge model provided by Harm-Bench as the model's safety performance. For utility, we report the model's performance on MT-Bench, IFEval and GSM8K, along with the compliance rate on XSTest.
